title: Transfers Out and Household Pooling of Wanderlane Traveller Club Points
content:
Points leave one Wanderlane Traveller Club card and arrive on another only where the tier held permits transfers, in whole thousands, at or above the tier's minimum and within the tier's annual ceiling. The annual ceiling is the largest total that may be transferred out in one calendar year.

## The conditions and what follows from them

**Where all of the following hold** — the tier held permits transfers; the amount is a whole multiple of 1000 points; the amount is at or above the transfer minimum of the tier held; the total transferred out in the calendar year, this amount included, is within the annual ceiling of the tier held; and no transfer carrying the same partner reference has already been recorded on this membership — **the transfer out is recorded.** The transfer fee is then charged per thousand points to the member sending them, and is never taken out of the points themselves.

**Where the tier held does not permit transfers**, points do not leave the card at all, whatever the amount.

**Where the amount is not a whole multiple of 1000 points**, or falls below the transfer minimum of the tier held, or would carry the calendar year's total beyond the annual ceiling of the tier held, the transfer is outside what the tier permits.

**Where a transfer carrying the same partner reference already stands recorded on this membership**, a further transfer out is not recorded. The ledger of transfers out standing against that membership is the authority, matched on the membership and on the partner reference exactly as it was supplied, and it is read before the transfer is recorded.

## What arrives, and in whose name

Transferred points arrive spendable, carry the receiving member's expiry term counted from the day they arrive, and never count toward the receiving member's qualification.

A transfer is final: points that have arrived are not sent back, and a disputed transfer is settled by the programme office rather than reversed at the desk.

## A household pool is not a transfer

A household pool is not a transfer. Contributions to a pool stay in the contributing member's name for qualification and are spendable by the pool's nominated booker.

## Points of judgement

The fee falls on the sending member and on the money side: the number of points that leaves the card is the number transferred and no more, and the number that arrives is the same number again.

Because the fee is charged per thousand points and transfers are made in whole thousands, the fee follows the number of thousands sent.
